verdicts.evidence: The page holds only the headline, the subtitle and two text cards, then blank white space; there is no button, link, price, date or venue anywhere.
Under the "Learn to swim" headline, the two cards "Join the lanes" (open lane swimming) and "Family hour" (Sunday sessions for children) cover different audiences.

The subtitle (about 22px, grey) and the card headings (about 20px, regular weight, near-black) are close in size, and the headings differ from the roughly 16px grey body text mainly by size and a slightly darker colour.
